therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: glucose-dependent insulin secretion and glycemic control
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with type 2 diabetes on metformin with or without sulfonylurea
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in HbA1c at Week 52

results.effect_size: LS mean difference (albiglutide - insulin glargine) = +0.11% HbA1c (95% CI: -0.04 to 0.27); albiglutide -0.67%, insulin glargine -0.79%
results.target_engagement_evidence: Albiglutide plasma concentrations measured at Week 8 pre-dose (mean 1642.83 ng/mL), Week 8 post-dose (1911.35 ng/mL), Week 24 pre-dose (2159.30 ng/mL), Week 24 post-dose (2748.15 ng/mL)
biomarker_changes: HbA1c change at Week 52: albiglutide -0.67%, insulin glargine -0.79%
HbA1c change at Week 156: albiglutide -0.83%, insulin glargine -1.00%
FPG change at Week 52: albiglutide -0.87 mmol/L, insulin glargine -2.06 mmol/L
FPG change at Week 156: albiglutide -0.83 mmol/L, insulin glargine -2.19 mmol/L
Body weight change at Week 52: albiglutide -1.05 kg, insulin glargine +1.56 kg
Body weight change at Week 156: albiglutide -3.47 kg, insulin glargine +0.90 kg
24-hour glucose AUC change at Week 52: albiglutide +0.457 mmol·h/L, insulin glargine -1.657 mmol·h/L
subgroup_findings: At Week 52, HbA1c <6.5% achieved: albiglutide 54 participants, insulin glargine 25 participants
At Week 52, HbA1c <7% achieved: albiglutide 156 participants, insulin glargine 78 participants
At Week 52, HbA1c <7.5% achieved: albiglutide 268 participants, insulin glargine 135 participants
At Week 156, HbA1c <6.5% achieved: albiglutide 33 participants, insulin glargine 18 participants
At Week 156, HbA1c <7% achieved: albiglutide 59 participants, insulin glargine 46 participants
At Week 156, HbA1c <7.5% achieved: albiglutide 85 participants, insulin glargine 71 participants
Median time to hyperglycemia rescue: albiglutide 107.57 weeks (95% CI: 96.43–143.43); insulin glargine not calculable (<50% of participants required rescue)
safety_signals: Serious adverse events reported including pneumonia, bronchitis, osteomyelitis, lobar pneumonia in albiglutide arm
Serious adverse events in insulin glargine arm included diverticulitis, urinary tract infection, cellulitis

dose_info.dose: 30 mg (with uptitration to 50 mg allowed from Week 4 based on glycemic response)
dose_info.dose_modifications: Uptitration from 30 mg to 50 mg weekly allowed beginning at Week 4 based on glycemic response
